reason: Suppressed means undeveloped or reduced to nothing, which fits aplastic (synonym undeveloped).
An obtusely rounded apex or base is obtuse; obtuse has the synonym roundish.
Semi-terete means half-cylindrical, flat on one side and rounded on the other, which is plano-convex.
Glandular-puberulous means minutely pubescent with glandular hairs. It is a fine-hair variant of glandular-pubescent, and the fineness is lost.
Diamond-shaped (rhombic) matches diamond shaped.
Regularly arranged is a regular spatial pattern.
Naviculate means boat-shaped, which is scaphoid.
Tuber-bearing means tubers are present, so tuber present fits.
Aciculate means needle-shaped, and subulate has the synonym needle-like. The word can also mean finely scratched on surfaces, which is rare.
Sclerenchymatous means made of or containing sclerenchyma, so sclerenchyma present fits.
Poorly defined usually describes indistinct margins or veins. It does not mean low visibility (inconspicuous). Reject, or map it to an 'indistinct' term if one exists.
Obtusely pointed means an obtuse apex (angle over 90°). It is not subacute, which is nearly acute.
Equal length of members of a set is equal in size.
Stigmatic means 'of the stigma' (stigmatic surface, lobes, hairs). It does not say a stigma is present, so entity_presence is wrong. Reject the rule.
Ragged margins are irregularly torn, which is lacerate.
Blackened means turned black, so black fits.
Lens-shaped (lenticular) is biconvex.
Apetalous means without petals, so petal absent fits.
Glandular-dotted means dotted with glands, which is gland-dotted.
Porose means having pores, which is porous.
Anastomosed means joined into a network, which is anastomosing.
Carnose means fleshy.
Corniculate means bearing small horns, which is horned.
Galeate means helmet- or hood-shaped, which is close to cucullate.
Ampliate means enlarged or widened, which is dilated.
Bicolorous means two colours on the same part. Discolorous means the two surfaces differ in colour. Reject, or map to a two-coloured term.
Nutant means nodding, which is drooping.
Anisophyllous means leaves of different size or shape on one plant. Unequal (size of a set) loses the shape part and the leaf-set meaning.
Nitid means shining or lustrous, which is glistening (synonym shiny).
Monadelphous means filaments united into one bundle. The generic connate loses 'one group', and diadelphous already has its own class under connate. Use a monadelphous class.
Liane (liana) is a climbing woody plant, which is climbing.
Broad-ovate is ovate; the broadness is lost but the shape class is right. FLOPO_0991024 is a temporary class awaiting PATO.
Glomerate means clustered into a head, which is aggregated.
Crisped is an edge shape. Curly also describes hairs, stems, tendrils and twigs, where an edge shape is wrong.
Lanuginose means woolly or cottony, which is lanate.
Not sheathing is the negation of sheathing.
Well defined usually describes distinct margins or veins, not conspicuousness. Reject, or map to a 'distinct' term.
Muriculate means minutely muricate, so the class is right although the fineness is lost.
Abbreviated means shortened, which is decreased length.
Not prolonged means not extended or elongated. It is not the same as not excurrent, which refers to extending beyond the apex. Reject.
Hollowed can mean concave on flat parts. On stems or fruits it means hollow (an internal cavity), and concave is wrong there.
Rambling (sprawling, scrambling growth) fits straggly for a whole plant.
Bossed means with a central knob or boss, which is umbonate.
Not peltate is the negation of peltate.
Hypogeal means below ground, which is subterranean.
Indusiate means having an indusium, so indusium present fits.
Bractless means without bracts, so bract absent fits.
Epunctate means without dots, which is not punctate.
Oblong-cylindric means an oblong cylinder, so cylindrical fits. The oblong aspect is lost.
Pulverulent means powdery or dusty, which is mealy.
